reviews.text: Rip off. This is crazy! There are only instructions on how to do these! I need to get my money back! Do not get this app! No one shows how to do them!
Fee. Don’t like being tricked into signing up for program only to find after I have entered all my personal information that there is a huge charge
Misleading. No audible directions - how do you do yoga by reading?
Not easy to figure out. Had to go to YouTube to figure out exercises. I didn’t get credit for completing a session.

Useless. Don’t buy this app, no daily exercise plan, no video or audio to guide you, you need to read a shady summary of the pause. App is very bad, hard to find what you want and don’t know what is good for me. Overall, I regret trying this app. 50$ for 4 months. Not cheap

Disappointed. I don’t recommend this app for those who have zero experience with yoga. Does not provide enough information, i.e., doesn’t explain how to set up a personalized routine, how many days, week, some individual pose pictures don’t match written descriptions, etc. Also can’t find where to stop auto renew. Refers me to ITunes and there is nothing there to cancel.

Scam. I am not even able to contact them on the app. Load failed is all it says. There is no way to cancel membership and no confirmation email when you join. No way to contact them. Do not be scammed.

reviews.text: No instructions. No sound or instructions. Visual example and does not notify of timing. Visual is only drawing and not even a real person. How do I get a refund?

Recent purchase. I was expecting videos to show me how to do the exercises. They were just some terrible pictures and abstract instructions. Was very disappointed.
I would return it if I could, but now I’m out $50

Not intuitive.. I have tried to reach you. No response. Why don’t you have audio instructions? It’s time consuming to have to stop and read the instructions to do the pose. It’s impossible to have a flow in the session when I have to stop and read the instructions. I will be asking Apple to refund my payment.
Chair Yoga. Chair Yoga offers no video.
Difficult tonavigate. Hard to find instructions on actual exercises. Very basic graphics and no obvious help
Sound on app. This app may be great but I cannot get any sound on my IPad, yes sound is on but app does not play sound. Any help? Or I will delete

No! No! No!. Unfortunately I did not check reviews before, there is no way to cancel the subscription (see other comments for why someone would want to cancel). The Terms indicate you can cancel through the ITune store, but there is no way to do so at any of the Apple sites.

Suspect fraud. Immediately after purchasing this app I was charged multiple times on my credit card for different amounts from this purchase. 
I tried to contact them but the message would not go through.

reviews.text: Totally Misleading!. I had no words after I started trying to use this App. There are NO interactive Ai people demonstrating HOW to do the exercises, just non-motion PICTURES. What a ripoff! This is SO not what I was led to believe to expect for this exercise App. If there was a negative Star rating, that’s what I would give this janky App. Way to take people’s hard-earned money. I am relearning how to walk after 57 straight days in hospital and 9 surgeries. I am extremely disappointed and feel TOTALLY MISLED!!! I have requested a Refund.
Chair yoga. Just started great so far!

Shouldn’t have to pay $49.99 for this garbage. Was not able to locate a feral subscription, app is pretty poor with similar exercises called different names and no variety … save your money and try something else !
Total rip off. Do not purchase. Nothing but a picture and timer. Purchased for my 78 year old mother. Total waste of money.
How to unsubscribe. Can’t find out how to unsubscribe.
No sound. I couldn’t get the sound up and I had to manually go to the next movement. I can’t find how the cancel the subscription.

Easy to use yoga. Chair yoga: it's a clean and intuitive app, there's a diverse set of excercises and curated work outs based on my goals. I selected to tone up everything , and followed some excercises based on dynamic excercises. It had a timer at the top and took around 10 minutes for the set. Makes it easier to make time in the day to work out.

Disappointing. Disappointed as there are only sketches against each exercise, you have to press on i for information & instructions on what to do. I was expecting to see live examples as I went through each exercise. I might as well have bought a book on yoga. Sad thing is I paid the one off yearly fee or I would have cancelled.

Not free. Not free
False advertising
